Cyrix Healthcare Acquires Blue Star E&E's MedTech Business

Cyrix Healthcare has acquired the MedTech business of Blue Star E&E. The acquisition involves the entirety of Blue Star E&E's MedTech Solutions business. Specific financial details of the transaction were not disclosed in the coverage. This move signifies a strategic expansion for Cyrix Healthcare within the medical technology sector.
